title: Act: Add sound and settings flags and actions to useUiStore
summary: Extend UiState with soundEnabled, settingsOpen and actions.
description: Extend src/store/uiStore.ts with soundEnabled (true), settingsOpen (false), toggleSound, setSoundEnabled and toggleSettings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the store, When toggleSound is called, Then soundEnabled is false
Given the store, When toggleSettings is called, Then settingsOpen is true

steps.action: Add to interface UiState: soundEnabled: boolean; settingsOpen: boolean; toggleSound: () => void; setSoundEnabled: (on: boolean) => void; toggleSettings: () => void.
In the create initializer add soundEnabled: true, settingsOpen: false and the three actions.
steps.code:
soundEnabled: true,
settingsOpen: false,
toggleSound: () => set((s) => ({ soundEnabled: !s.soundEnabled })),
setSoundEnabled: (on) => set({ soundEnabled: on }),
toggleSettings: () => set((s) => ({ settingsOpen: !s.settingsOpen })),
